page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, backed by 128.0 GB of RAM, which equates to 4.0 GB of memory per core. The CPU includes a 35 MB L3 cache and supports AVX-512 vector extensions, AVX512_VNNI, and AES cryptography. It operates on a KVM hypervisor, lacks local storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance in the average performance tier across all evaluated metrics. It achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1287.0 and a multi-core score of 11107.0, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 29517.51. In memory bandwidth tests, it reaches 1705.41 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 109.89 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. For data processing, the server handles multi-threaded Bzip3 decompression at 140.98 GB/sec and Redis SET operations at 28.91 million operations per second.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated compute resources, this server is suitable for general-purpose workloads, web serving, and database operations. The lack of bundled local storage requires external block storage attachment, which represents a structural tradeoff for disk-heavy applications. However, its dedicated CPU allocation and AVX-512 instruction support provide stable processing capabilities for software compilation, static web serving, and light LLM inference tasks.
